2609.31176.title: Semantic Navigation for Issue Localization in Code Repository
2609.31176.paper_summary: Repository-level issue localization aims to identify and rank the files and functions relevant to resolving a reported issue. LLM agents approach this task iteratively: they identify a set of potentially relevant locations, inspect the corresponding code, and revise their judgments about these candidates as new evidence is acquired. Existing environments, however, provide limited support for this loop: agents must search for unresolved relation targets, reconstruct entity semantics from raw source code, and revise candidates without evidential basis. To address these limitations, we present SemNav, a framework that leverages deterministic retrieval to seed a broad candidate set and an LLM agent to continually refine that set, thereby combining initial coverage with evidence-guided revision. SemNav supports this process through three key components. A Semantic Navigation Graph resolves program relations on demand through a language server, enabling direct navigation to related entities across files. Issue-conditioned Semantic Cards provide compact, source-grounded interpretations of each entity's role and relevance to the issue. A persistent Candidate Workspace records each candidate together with its evidential basis, enabling grounded verification, revision, and ranking. Across SWE-bench Lite and PLocBench, SemNav outperforms existing baselines, improving File Hit@10 from 68.33\% to 82.67\% with Gemma 4B. Component ablations and trajectory analysis support the complementary roles of all three components, while Semantic Cards reduce working-context load by 48.2\% relative to full-source reading. SemNav further ranks first on all seven evidence-quality metrics on SWE-Explore and improves downstream issue resolution from 44.00\% to 52.33\%.
2609.31176.paper_summary_zh: 儲存庫級別的問題定位旨在識別和排名與解決報告問題相關的文件和函數。LLM 代理以迭代的方式處理這項任務：他們識別一組潛在相關的位置，檢查相應的代碼，並在獲得新證據時修正對這些候選者的判斷。然而，現有環境對這一循環的支持有限：代理必須尋找未解決的關聯目標，從原始源代碼重建實體語義，並在沒有證據基礎的情況下修正候選者。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 SemNav，一個利用確定性檢索來生成廣泛候選集的框架，並通過 LLM 代理不斷精煉該集合，從而結合初步覆蓋和基於證據的修訂。SemNav 通過三個關鍵組件支持這一過程。一個語義導航圖通過語言伺服器按需解析程序關係，實現跨文件的相關實體的直接導航。問題條件的語義卡提供每個實體的角色和與問題相關性的緊湊、基於源的解釋。一個持久的候選工作區記錄每個候選者及其證據基礎，實現基於證據的驗證、修訂和排名。在 SWE-bench Lite 和 PLocBench 中，SemNav 超越了現有基準，將 File Hit@10 從 68.33\% 提升至 82.67\%，使用 Gemma 4B。組件消融和軌跡分析支持所有三個組件的互補角色，而語義卡將工作上下文負擔減少了 48.2\%，相對於完整源代碼閱讀。SemNav 進一步在 SWE-Explore 上的七個證據質量指標中排名第一，並將下游問題解決率從 44.00\% 提升至 52.33\%。
